spec.description: VF-010 (verification/findings.md): the fix budgets the own checker's branch probes in solver conflicts instead of wall-clock time (Engine::probe, lib/src/bmc/mod.rs). To check that no recorded own-checker verdict changes with it, the benchmark's own-checker runs are recorded at the fix (this job, which runs at the commit that adds it, the fix) and at the fix's parent (run 2 of 2, --revision c307e721), and a later quick job compares the two outputs, as the examples stream does for VF-014. Not compared with lib/benchmark/results.json, which VF-014 shows is stale. This job only records: it passes when the benchmark runs.
